explanation: L0/N1771+ is a token-identity detector: input attribution puts 100% of every peak on the current token and the activation is unchanged when surrounding context changes, so the pole fires iff the current token is one of a sparse, non-semantic lexicon of word-pieces. Its strongest and by far most frequent member is the bare subword 'ors' (1.12 of max, reached by any word the tokenizer splits as ...+ors: endeavors, inspectors, councillors, aggressors, even nonsense 'zorblors'), followed by the standalone tokens ' First' (1.11), ' self' (1.09), 'Self' (0.98) and ' sun' (0.97) and a long tail of rare fragments ('ellt', 'odend', 'elfth', 'teenth') and single non-Latin characters (ล 0.99, 期 0.95, τι 0.95, ح 0.92). It is neither morphological nor semantic: whole-word '-ors' plurals the tokenizer keeps intact ('actors', 'vendors', 'factors', 'vectors', 'errors', 'authors') and 'self'-containing reflexives ('myself', 'herself', 'itself') score near 0, as do function words, punctuation, whitespace and almost all ordinary content words and digits.
